assessments.reasoning: The dated Query Recommendation explicitly assigns an empty default graph to a query-described dataset consisting of one or more FROM NAMED clauses and no FROM clause. The independently acquired Protocol §2.1.4 distinguishes protocol override and implementation-defined absent-description cases.

challenge.method: Compare a named-only query description, one with a FROM clause, and an incompatible protocol-level dataset. Consider the case without any dataset description and the permitted request refusal.
challenge.results: When the query’s named-only description is used, the default graph is empty. FROM changes the queries’ described default construction, and a different dataset from the protocol takes precedence. With neither description the service may use an implementation-defined dataset. Refusal gives no ordinary result.

limitations: Only the dataset description when accepted and used is covered. Named graph content, endpoint policies and graph retrieval remain separate fields.
